plan.title: Vendor Revert to Previous Bid Revision

steps.note: Create the RFQ event needed for the vendor revision scenario.
Provide the mandatory event title before publishing.
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction stage.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add one product for the vendor bid sheet.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Commit a bidding schedule required for publication.
Invite the QA vendor who will submit the revisions.
Publish the event so the vendor can bid.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event's RFQ bid sheet in the vendor portal.
Confirm the initial vendor bid was accepted.
Confirm the revised vendor bid was accepted.

args.need: use the vendor portal's revert option to restore the previous bid of 100 as a new revision; if revert is not offered, record that outcome

steps.note: The catalog has no step for the vendor-portal revert control or its revision-trail outcome.
Return to the buyer console to inspect the comparison grid.
Open Master QCS after the vendor's revert attempt.
Verify that Master QCS uses the restored bid value of 100 when the revert succeeds.
